title: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress says the company will stay "disciplined and selective" in supporting neoclouds; CoreWeave and Nebius jump 9%+ after hours (Ina Fried/Axios)
summary: Ina Fried / Axios: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress says the company will stay “disciplined and selective” in supporting neoclouds; CoreWeave and Nebius jump 9%+ after hours — Nvidia's interim CEO said Tuesday that the company will be “disciplined” as it decides how much to invest in neoclouds and other AI customers going forward.
contentText:
Ina Fried / Axios :

Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress says the company will stay “disciplined and selective” in supporting neoclouds; CoreWeave and Nebius jump 9%+ after hours   —  Nvidia's interim CEO said Tuesday that the company will be “disciplined” as it decides how much to invest in neoclouds and other AI customers going forward.
